title: British MotoGP
metaDescription: British MotoGP: verified dates, location and OneSliders event context for Motogp.

overview.about: The British Grand Prix is MotoGP's home round in the United Kingdom, held at the high-speed Silverstone circuit since 2010. Its fast, flowing corners and often changeable weather make it one of the most demanding races on the calendar, and the huge grandstands give it a big-event atmosphere. The 2027 dates have not yet been confirmed.
overview.nextEvent: The 2027 British Grand Prix at Silverstone has not had its dates confirmed yet; the provisional MotoGP calendar is still to be finalised. Silverstone's long, fast layout typically makes it one of the season's highlights once scheduled.
